description: The bar chart titled “QLoRA” illustrates GPU memory usage for several fine-tuning approaches, with the categories shown along the horizontal axis and the measured memory on the vertical axis. The x-axis consists of six method labels—“Full FT,” “MTL-FT,” “TAG,” “LoRA,” “QLoRA,” and “Ours”—displayed in that left-to-right order with diagonally rotated text; no explicit sorting (e.g., ascending/descending) is indicated beyond this sequence. The y-axis is labeled “GPU Memory (GB)” and uses a linear scale with labeled ticks at approximately 0, 20, 40, and 60 GB, with the tallest bar extending a bit above the 60 GB tick (into the low 70s). Each category is represented by a single vertical bar: “Full FT” is an orange bar at roughly ~72–73 GB, “MTL-FT” is orange at about ~39–40 GB, “TAG” is orange at about ~21–22 GB, “LoRA” is orange at about ~21–22 GB, “QLoRA” is orange at about ~12–13 GB, and “Ours” is a green bar at about ~21–22 GB. There is no visible legend, stacking, or grouping beyond one bar per method, and no bars appear specially annotated or outlined aside from the distinct color used for “Ours” compared with the orange baseline bars.
